ratings_why.fun: One pile pulled four ways (Tally's gold, Onward fuel, Ole's missiles, Ferrywife's stats) plus the board-as-safe-spot trick gives a real choice every turn; the Tier 1-2 cards are plain.
ratings_why.distinct: An off-board reserve that is fight HP, currency and ammunition at once, plus a passing Banner, plays unlike any of today's tribes, though the Kit token itself is familiar.

verdict_why: The web of overlaps is in place and v3's fixes landed; what is left is a one-line wording note and taste, so more rounds would make it different, not better.

points.text: Say whether one Litter Keeper's extra Kits trigger a second Litter Keeper; as written they do, up to each cap, and players will ask.
Tunic Weaver's choice is the same every game; a third option like 'spend 2 Burrow Kits: Kit size +1/+1' would tie it into the spending puzzle early.
Raft-builder can buff a Kit on the board, which loses it if burrowed; one card that rewards keeping a big named Kit on the board would turn that trap into a build.
Yellowcoat Squeaker does only the obvious job; letting its Kit start with Onward would seed the front-unit play from Tier 1.

standouts.why: Brother Onward turns the Onward chain into a growing Banner, and wants a Kit in front and a Mire or Hunker unit behind: a cross-tribe puzzle.
Identical Cousin spends a Kit on triples for any tribe, or a second Herald that counts what the first just made.
Ole makes every Burrow Kit a missile-or-body choice, and his falling Kits feed Gerd and Cantor.

weakest.why: Yellowcoat Squeaker is a plain token maker with no tie to the Burrow or the front.
Tunic Weaver is a one-time pick with no decision after the first game.
Snowbed Nester is a plain End of Turn maker; Brood Matron does the job more interestingly.

flags.note: With Old Mother Lemen and a Burrow of 15, the Banner can reach about +60/+60 in one fight; fight-only, but worth a sim.
Golden Cantor with Gerd, Ole and a long Onward chain stacks huge fight stats on one unit.
Two Litter Keepers: whether each one's extra Kits trigger the other isn't spelled out.
